scope: Offline riverfront rendering, driving, traffic, environment and exploration assets.

assets.source: Project-authored truss, deck and sail geometry informed by public dimensions.
assets.license: Original project geometry; SRFDCL reference imagery is excluded.
assets.geometry: 285 m modeled truss, canopy and deck between the two promenade abutments. The real reference is nominally 300 m. Instanced tubes and boardwork surround four procedural fabric sections.
assets.textures: Project palette and local paving materials.
assets.collision: Continuous central deck and rail collision. Bollards exclude cars at the foot entrance.
assets.lod: Instanced elements use engine culling. No authored HLOD.
assets.verification: Atal landing capture; native prior deck and vehicle-block tests.

assets.source: Project-authored two-wing arcade fitted to a riverfront site and a mapped city plot.
assets.license: Original project geometry with CC0 ambientCG surface maps.
assets.geometry: Modular storeys, colonnade, shutter bays, original 78 cm condenser plus shelf brackets.
assets.textures: 1K brick, plaster, normal and roughness maps; original glazing.
assets.collision: Separate solid wings and columns; open alley and perimeter walk.
assets.lod: World mesh instances, no authored building HLOD.
assets.verification: Fixed shopfront view and six-leg perimeter walks on both maps. The surrounding frontage also has original side and service elevations.

assets.source: Original deterministic geometry placed on the existing riverfront buildings. Scale and service details were interpreted from the documented regional references.
assets.license: Original project geometry. The brick, plaster and concrete inputs retain their ambientCG CC0 licences.
assets.geometry: Both side walls and the rear receive separate elevations. Projecting stone sunshades, open terracotta stair louvres, sills, service doors and rainwater pipes are placed in centimetres.
assets.textures: Uses the existing 1K material scans and the original world-space rising-damp treatment on vertical masonry.
assets.collision: The existing building shell supplies collision. The surface fittings share its footprint or shallow wall clearance. The surrounding public lane is walkable.
assets.lod: Instanced material batches. Secondary blocks use fewer bays and simpler trim. No authored building HLOD.
assets.verification: The native standalone character completed the 57.84 m four-sided circuit and stayed grounded. Fixed service-lane captures were checked at golden hour and night.

assets.source: ambientCG Asphalt 033 and Asphalt 019 plus project-authored wear, irregular service cuts and roadside dust.

assets.textures: 1K color, DirectX tangent normal and roughness maps. Asphalt 033 sampled at 2.5 m.

assets.verification: Normal chase camera and 45 m native drive with road contact.

assets.lod: Animation update budget and distance culling.

assets.category: player head, clothing and wearable accessory
assets.source: Original geometry and UV artwork from Scripts/make-morning-wardrobe.py, Scripts/make-resident-head.py and Scripts/tailor-riverfront-kurta.py. The fictional residents use the CC0 MakeHuman hm08 body. Scripts/import-morning-wardrobe.py uses Unreal Interchange.
assets.license: Project-authored haircut, watch and texture artwork. Public resident topology uses the CC0 MakeHuman body credited under district residents.
assets.geometry: The fitted, head-attached swept haircut has 5,451 triangles and 137 tapered edge locks. The alternative cropped style uses the original scalp. An independently skinned kurta stole and short placket follow the 18-bone resident skeleton; concealed trouser geometry ends inside the hem. The original 908-triangle unbranded watch has a 38 mm case, dial, twelve hour marks and strap.
assets.textures: Original 1024 px fictional face and tailoring maps, 512 px dark hair and iris maps, and 256 px cotton weave colour and tangent normals. Shirt construction includes collar edges, a pocket, back yoke, placket, buttons and a continuous hem. Measured public garment UVs give approximately 0.9–1.2 mm yarn spacing.
assets.collision: The hair and wristwatch attach to the animated head and hand bones and have collision disabled. The character capsule governs locomotion.
assets.lod: The player-only haircut and watch each use one geometric LOD. Texture mips filter the woven yarns, hair and eye artwork with distance.
assets.verification: The M1 Max packaged wardrobe and shop demonstrated the dark hairstyle, defined pupils, correct weave scale and visible shirt purchase. Following that inspection, the shoulders and hem were revised and a skinned kurta stole was imported on the original skeleton.

assets.source: Original unbadged camera, neck strap and A3 print portfolio assembled on the two visitors by RiverfrontSocialWalk.cpp.
assets.license: Original Sabarmati accessory designs and local fleet materials. Basic cube and cylinder meshes come from the installed Unreal Engine.
assets.geometry: Camera housing is 13 cm wide with two lens sections and twin strap segments. The 42.6 × 30.2 cm portfolio has two covers, paper edges, bound spine and webbing handle.
assets.textures: Existing rubber, iron, teal and cream materials supply the surface finishes.
assets.collision: Both props attach to reference-pose skeletal bones and animate with their owners. Decorative pieces have collision disabled.
assets.lod: Small accessories cull at 35 m.
assets.verification: Compiled with the native Unreal 5.8.4 Mac toolchain. The first-morning review checks the visiting photographer and print-shop customer during their separate outings.
